name: Thomas
bio: Thomas was one of the twelve apostles Jesus named and sent out with authority to heal and cast out demons, instructed to go first to Israel rather than Gentiles or Samaritans (Matthew 10:1-5). When Jesus proposed returning to Judea, where the Jews had recently sought to stone him, to raise Lazarus from death, Thomas told the other disciples, "Let us also go, that we may die with him" (John 11:16). His doubt and eventual confession of faith are told in detail in the chapters ahead, especially in John's Gospel.
